product_one_liner.value: Design Arena lets people generate and compare AI-created websites, apps and other media, while giving AI labs crowdsourced human-preference benchmarks to evaluate and improve their models.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing link or pricing page found; the terms state that use has no fees unless otherwise specified.

named_customers.notes: The cited pages explicitly describe these organizations using Design Arena for model evaluation; paid-contract status is not disclosed for each organization.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 12 employees; its separate company-size label still says 1–10.

eng_blog.notes: At least two how-built posts cover Agent Runner and the HTML-to-PPTX implementation; author Grace Li has software-engineering and AI/ML-research experience.

public_docs.notes: Public developer documentation includes introduction, quickstart, API overview and API references.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live opening: Member of Technical Staff, ML Engineer.

model_provider.value: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, Mistral, Kimi
model_provider.notes: The company explicitly names these providers as supported by its Agent Runner evaluation harness; this is a multi-provider benchmarking product, not a single-model application.

compliance_certs.notes: No SOC 2, ISO 27001, HIPAA, PCI DSS or GDPR certification is claimed on the privacy page. GDPR is discussed as applicable privacy law, not as a certification.

last_funding.notes: Announced August 3, 2026, for Intelligence, the company behind Design Arena.

raised_18mo.notes: The August 2026 seed announcement falls within May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The public board lists five openings, none titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: The blog lists the introduction of Mobile Arena on June 9, 2026; its HTML-to-PPTX library was also open-sourced on July 10, 2026, within the requested window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No complete public team roster with executive start dates or dated C-level/VP arrival or departure announcement was found for November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026; the available profiles do not establish a negative.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Readable engineering job descriptions name no CRM, sales-engagement or marketing-automation system.
